newsitem.title: FRANCE: Broker raises recommendation on Promodes.
newsitem.headline: Broker raises recommendation on Promodes.

text.p: Brokerage Dupont Denant raised its recommendation on the stock in retailer Promodes to outperform from performance in line, market operators said on Tuesday.

"The change in their recommendation, following a meeting with the management, reflects the group's re-centring on its core businesses and the sale of its money-losing German unit," a portfolio manager said.
Another market operator said Dupont-Denant expected a strong rebound on the order of 30 percent in Promodes's 1997 results.
The stock closed up 19 francs at 1,420.
